newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras target price raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras target price raised.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said it has raised its 12-month target price on Brazilian telecoms giant Telebras to $170 from $140 following the stock's continued strong performance.
-- J.P. Morgan analyst Simon Flannery said in a report that recent strong rises in Telebras' already have sent the stock through his previous target price.

-- "We believe that there is some upside potential to our 1998 estimates and, therefore to our target price, but given yesterday's announcement that Telebras would have to curtail 1997 spending, we prefer to remain somewhat cautious," he wrote.
